meta.title: dodi: The learning friend that grows with your child
meta.description: A self-improving, voice-first learning companion for kids. It remembers each child, builds custom games on the spot, and is privacy-first and open source.

hero.title: The learning friend that grows with your child
hero.subtitle: Your kids talk and play with dodi. It remembers what makes each one tick and invents games made just for them.
hero.trustDevices: Works on devices you already own

trust.voice: Voice-first: no reading or typing needed

pillars.title: A learning buddy, who also learns themselves
pillars.lead: Learning works best in a trusted and fun environment. The goal of dodi is to build a lasting relationship. A digital friend, who fosters the curiosity of your child.
pillars.p1Body: Session by session, dodi gets to know each child (what they love, where they're stuck) and adapts every chat, lesson and game. It remembers across sessions and grows right alongside them.
pillars.p2Body: Together with dodi, parents can build custom learning games in seconds. There are no limits to your creativity.
pillars.p3Body: Conversations are end-to-end encrypted and dodi runs on AI keys you bring yourself. You can read or erase everything it remembers anytime. No ads, no tracking, no selling of data.
pillars.p4Body: All of dodi's code is open for anyone to read, audit, improve or self-host. No black boxes around your children, just software you can actually inspect and trust.

how.title: Learning by do-di-ing
how.s1Body: Your child just talks, and dodi listens, chats back, and turns curiosity into play. No keyboard, no menus full of buttons.
how.s2Body: After every chat, dodi updates what it knows about your child and gently tunes how it teaches: at their pace, in their language.
how.s3Body: Custom games and explanations arrive the way your child learns best, and dodi gets a little better every single time.

products.title: One brain. Your choice of body.
products.lead: Start today with the app on a device you already have, then add the Companion when it arrives.
products.appBody: The full dodi experience on the tablet, phone or computer you already own. Talk, learn and build games together, starting today.
products.companionBody: An optional friend for the shelf. Same brain, same memory, now a real presence in the room.

privacy.title: Your child's world stays in your hands
privacy.lead: Everything is designed so that you, not an ad network or an algorithm, decide what happens with your family's data.
privacy.i1Body: Your child's conversations are encrypted end-to-end. Not even we can read them. Your family's words stay your family's alone.
privacy.i2Body: Connect your own Gemini or Claude key. Conversations go straight to the provider you chose, never through a middleman mining your kids' words.
privacy.i3Body: Every memory dodi forms about your child is visible in plain language. Read it, edit it, add notes, or wipe it, anytime.
privacy.i4Body: There's no engagement machine trying to keep your kid glued to a screen, and no data for sale, ever.
privacy.osBody: We build dodi in the open. Read the code, audit exactly how it handles your data, contribute improvements, or run your own private instance. Trust shouldn't require taking our word for it.

about.quote: The dodo wasn't stupid. It was just <accent>underestimated</accent>.
about.body: History got the dodo wrong. We named our learning friend after it as a reminder: every child is smarter, more capable and more curious than they're given credit for. It all began when a father of three went looking for a learning experience that was actually fun, and couldn't find one.

cta.title: Make learning their favourite part of the day
cta.lead: Start free on the device you already have. Your kids are ready to meet dodi.

footer.tagline: A self-improving, privacy-first learning companion for kids. Open source, and built by parents who wanted learning to be fun again.
footer.copyright: © {year} dodi. Made with care for curious kids.

app.metaDescription: How the dodi app works: a voice-first companion that remembers each child, builds custom games on demand, runs on your own AI keys, and speaks every child's language.
app.heroTitle: Create fun learning games with your kids
app.heroLead: The full dodi experience runs right in the browser, on a tablet, phone or laptop. Here's how the app actually works.
app.f1Title: A friend your kid can just talk to
app.f1Body: Everything starts with voice. Your child taps once and starts chatting: asking questions, telling stories, playing games. No reading menus, no typing, no screens full of buttons to get lost in.
app.f1aRest: : dodi listens, replies out loud, and keeps the thread going.
app.f1bRest: : Perfect from age three, long before kids can type.
app.f1cRest: : Calm pacing, an encouraging tone, never overstimulating.
app.f2Title: It remembers, and gets better every day
app.f2Body: After every conversation, dodi quietly updates what it knows about your child: their interests, their level, what clicks and what frustrates them. The next session picks up right where the last one left off.
app.f2aRest: : Lessons and games adjust as they progress.
app.f2bBold: You can read all of it
app.f2bRest: : Every memory is shown in plain language, editable anytime.
app.f2cRest: : Add context (allergies, school topics, sensitivities) that dodi always respects.
app.mem1: Loves dinosaurs, the Triceratops most of all.
app.mem2: Working on numbers 10–20, adding and subtracting.
app.mem3: Warms up slowly with new games and likes a friendly intro.
app.memNote:
– Nora reads well but is still learning all her letters.
– Please keep counting in the 10–20 range for now.
app.f3Body: The Game studio turns one sentence into a real, playable game. dodi already knows your child, so a wish like "a counting game" comes out with their favourite dinosaurs and exactly the right difficulty. And for quiet moments, a shelf of ready-made games is included out of the box, like mandala drawing.
app.f3aRest: : Describe the game in one sentence, and dodi does the rest.
app.f3bRest: : dodi weaves in their interests and current skills automatically.
app.f3cRest: : Classics like mandala drawing are ready before you create anything.
app.gsWish: Create a counting game for my 4yo
app.gsThink: Creating game for 4yo. She likes dinos and can count up to 10.
app.gsGameQ: How many dinos do you see?
app.f4Body: A simple "soul document" you can edit defines dodi's whole personality. A giggly playmate, a calm bedtime storyteller, a patient maths coach: set the tone, the teaching style and the boundaries, separately for each child.
app.f4bRest: : Topics, language and limits that you decide.
app.f4cRest: : One for your four-year-old, another for your eight-year-old.
app.soulP2: - Cheers loudly for every small win
app.soulA1: - Ask, don't tell: let the child guess first
app.soulB1: - Never rush. Never shame a wrong answer.
app.f5Title: Your keys. Your models. Your data.
app.f5Body: Under the hood, dodi runs on AI providers you connect yourself. Plug in your own Google Gemini or Anthropic Claude key, and your child's conversations go straight to the provider you trust, never pooled, mined or resold by us.
app.f5aRest: : We never sit between your child and the model harvesting words.
app.f5bRest: : Choose the voice and the thinking model that fit your family.
app.f5cRest: : A complete, readable log of every session is yours to inspect.
app.f6Body: Learning is even more fun, and more effective, when it's done together. The optional friend system is designed to encourage being together in person and making learning social: no content feeds, no likes, nothing engineered to keep kids scrolling.
app.f6aRest: : Kids can share drawings and favourite games with their friends.
app.f6bRest: : You decide whether your child can add friends or be added by others.
app.f6cRest: : No public directory. Kids can only be added with their personal friend code.
app.frQrHint: Show this to a friend so they can scan it and add you.
app.teaserTitle: The same dodi, now a friend on the shelf
app.teaserBody: Everything you just saw also powers the dodi Companion, a device for the shelf arriving in 2027. Same brain, same memory, same games.
app.ctaTitle: Your scrolling finger might hurt by now
app.ctaLead: Better give dodi a free try already.

companion.metaTitle: dodi Companion: The learning friend that lives in the room
companion.metaDescription: The dodi Companion is a learning friend for the shelf, shipping in 2027. It only listens when needed, has a scheduled night mode, same brain as the app, with privacy you can see and feel.
companion.heroTitle: A learning friend that lives in the room
companion.heroLead: The dodi Companion is a dedicated friend for the shelf. No tablet to hand over, no app to get lost in, just a warm voice and a friendly face your child can turn to any time. It's an optional addition, and dodi is already complete on the app.
companion.sameBrainLead: The Companion is an optional add-on, and dodi already works beautifully on the app alone. The device simply gives everything a home in the room, and because it lives in your house, it can do a few things the cloud never can.
companion.whyDeviceTitle: Some things a tablet just can't do
companion.v1Body: Its small display is simply dodi's face: no apps, no feeds, no rabbit holes to fall into.
companion.v2Body: No unlocking, no handing over your phone, and no open microphone. A quick double tap wakes dodi; the rest of the time it's simply quiet.
companion.v3Body: A character that lives on the shelf and your child bonds with, not one more icon on a screen.
companion.v4Body: Designed to sit quietly in the room and join in when invited, never to grab for attention.
companion.v5Body: A soft fabric shell, no fragile glass and no fiddly ports, made to be dropped, hugged and loved.
companion.v6Body: A single friendly device the household can talk to, with a separate profile for each child.
companion.privacyEyebrow: Privacy you can see and feel
companion.privacyTitle: A friend in the room you can actually trust
companion.privacyLead: A device that lives in your child's room only earns its place if privacy is physical, visible, and yours to control. So that's exactly how we built it.
companion.p1Body: Every conversation is encrypted end-to-end, so not even our servers can read it. Your family's data belongs to your family alone.
companion.p2Body: The face and light make it obvious the moment dodi is awake. There's no hidden recording: what you see is what's happening.
companion.p3Body: The Companion only starts listening when your child double-taps the screen. Until then, nothing is heard and nothing is streamed.
companion.p4Body: Just like the app: conversations go to the AI provider you connect, every memory is yours to read or delete, and nothing is ever sold.
companion.p5Body: On the schedule you set, voice interactions switch off for the night, and dodi quietly moonlights as your child's alarm clock until morning.
companion.encryptionCaption: All sensitive data is encrypted on the device before it travels anywhere. What leaves your home is unreadable to everyone but you.
companion.homeServerTitle: Automations that run in your home, not our cloud
companion.homeServerBody: Because every conversation is end-to-end encrypted, not even our servers can read your child's data, which means they can't quietly work on it in the background either. The Companion can. Sitting safely in your home, it doubles as a private server that runs dodi's automations locally, right where the keys already live.
companion.hs1Rest: : overnight, the Companion can dream up new games and challenges tuned to your child, ready and waiting in the morning.
companion.hs2Rest: : automations run on the device in your home, so your data never has to leave it to work its magic.
companion.hs3Rest: : the app stays fully featured on its own; the Companion simply adds these automatic touches.
companion.hardwareTitle: Soft on the outside, smart on the inside
companion.hardwareLead: A first look at what we're building. Details will firm up as we get closer to 2027.
companion.s1Body: A soft, knitted fabric sphere that's made to be dropped, carried and hugged.
companion.s2Body: A round display where dodi smiles, listens and plays along, with no menus to read.
companion.s3Body: Far-field microphones for natural talk, listening only once dodi is awake.
companion.s4Body: A room-filling speaker tuned for gentle, easy-to-understand speech.
companion.newsletterBody: Subscribe to our newsletter to get updates about the Companion device and new app features.
companion.newsletterNote: No spam, no selling your data. Unsubscribe anytime.

about.metaTitle: About dodi: Why a dodo, and why we do things differently
about.metaDescription: The story behind dodi: why we named a learning companion after the misunderstood dodo, how it started with a father of three, and the principles we build by.
about.heroLead: We firmly believe that kids are naturally curious, and that learning should feed that curiosity rather than work against it.
about.story1: The idea to found dodi came to Alexander Birke, a father of three wild and wonderful children, when he was confronted with the harsh reality of the school system. Repetitive tasks, which seemingly hadn't evolved much in the 30 years since his own school days, robbed his children of their joy of learning and led to a great deal of frustration and stress. As a tech enthusiast, he tried out the existing educational apps, only to find that unfortunately, these were either very boring or not tailored individually enough to his children's needs. He thought to himself: There has to be a better way. Motivated by the rapidly advancing AI technology, he began to build a system that adapted individually to the needs of his children. It was meant to be easily operated via voice while also being fun.
about.story2: From this, dodi was born: an adaptive learning buddy that listens, remembers, invents supportive games, and treats every child as the curious, autonomous person they already are. Alexander's children love dodi because it's fun to have a cheerful learning companion who encourages their creativity and meets them exactly where they are.
about.founderRole: Founder · Dad of three · Chief dad-joke-teller
about.founderBio: His parents wanted him to become a teacher. He tried hard not to become a teacher. Now he teaches AI how to teach kids.
about.dodo1: For centuries, the belief stubbornly persisted that dodos were clumsy and not particularly smart. Nothing could be further from the truth.
about.dodo2: The dodo lived exclusively on the isolated island of Mauritius in the Indian Ocean. For millions of years, there were no significant natural predators on the island: no wolves, no big cats, and no humans. Since it didn't have to flee from anyone, instead of using its energy for exhausting flight, it preferred to use it for extensive walks on the ground and gradually lost its escape instinct entirely. A phenomenon known as "island tameness."
about.dodo3: When sailors first arrived on Mauritius in the late 16th century, the dodos didn't run away. They had no concept of a predator and, out of pure curiosity, simply walked right up to the sailors. The sailors mistook this biological naivety for profound stupidity.
about.dodo4LeadIn: In truth, it was curious and innocent.
about.dodo4Rest: It faced the world openly, without fear, and was punished for the very trust that made it so wonderful. Just like the dodo, children also face the world with open curiosity, only to be treated condescendingly far too often. The dodo thus became a symbol and a poignant reminder that we should never stop appreciating and nurturing the individual abilities of our children.
about.factBody: Modern CT scans revealed that dodos had an enlarged olfactory bulb. This means they had an excellent sense of smell – a relatively rare trait in birds – which they likely used to sniff out fruit, nuts, and small invertebrates on the dense forest floor.
about.principlesLead: A few principles we're not willing to trade away, even when they're the harder path.
about.pr1Body: All sensitive data is end-to-end encrypted before reaching our servers. You decide who can access it.
about.pr2Body: Learning should make kids laugh. The moment it feels like a worksheet, we've gotten it wrong.
about.pr3Body: Voice-first, so it works for kids who can't yet read or type, and speaks each child's own language, at their own level. Learning that meets every child where they are.
about.pr4Body: No autoplay, no dark patterns. We optimize for kids' learning success, rather than usage metrics.
about.pr5Body: Made by parents and shaped by the families and their kids who use it. There's no more honest feedback than from kids.
about.pr6Body: Our code is public. You should never have to take a company's word for what happens around your kids.
about.ctaLead: Start free today, or follow along as we build the Companion in the open.
